the Combustion v2.4b FA-1 grid (SIM on an ASSUMED construct; grid counts are not probabilities; the grid data are unchanged in v2.4c,
interfaces/combustion.json 661db0a593462382, whose fa1_grid_statistics_v2p4c records Z3' as OPEN and fa1_p_torch_v2p4c the R4-01 text);
margins are the published tables (negatives SHOWN AS FOUND).  Not physical approval.  Import-safe: inside_v2() and esp_max() can be
imported without running the checks.

WHAT CHANGES IN v2
(1) Z3 RESTATED (R4-02).  The FA-1 head peaks above the v1 ceiling 75.519 bar abs are physical SIM bracket cases (46 of 896, maximum 88.02;
    REV-COMB-4).  A higher ceiling with the v1 shape limits does not bound the structure (88.1 with <= 3.0 ms above 63.1 and a >= 0.8 ms rise
    admits ESP 171.45 bar abs > FA1S 151.04), and no tighter time / rise / ceiling limits both admit the grid and bound the ESP (option 2
    below, with numbers).  Z3 v2 is REV-COMB-4's Z3' AS WRITTEN plus the two v1 shape conditions kept as the FA-1 class:
      Z3 v2:  63.1 < P_head <= 88.1 bar abs, AND
              S(T) <= 151.04 bar abs (FA1S) at every period T in 0.02-50 ms (the published 406-period grid), AND
              the window from the first to the last crossing of 63.1 bar abs <= 3.0 ms, AND the 10-90 % rise of the first rise to the
              peak >= 0.8 ms (both kept from v1; every grid case meets them, so the grid classification equals Z3' exactly).
    S(T) = 1.01325 + max_t x(t), x'' + (2 pi / T)^2 x = (2 pi / T)^2 g(t), undamped, x = x' = 0 at the record start (before the light,
    chamber at ambient or below), g = P_head - 1.01325 bar piecewise linear between samples and held at its last value after the record
    (its free vibration added); S = the larger of g clipped at 0 and g unclipped: the Combustion v2.4b 16.2 / REV-COMB-4 convention,
    reproduced here on the 896 grid histories.
    THE RECORD (what a post-run check evaluates; the grid's own form): one light's head-end pressure from before the light (first sample
    at or below 2.0 bar abs; grid records start at 0.05-1.07 bar abs; a start above ambient adds at most 2 (P0 - 1.01325) bar, conservative)
    with S evaluated on the LIGHT WINDOW, from the record start to 150 ms after the first crossing of 8 bar abs (the LIGHT_SPIKE start),
    held after it.  Every grid record ends 61-129 ms after that crossing, so the grid evaluation is the published convention exactly; the
    window keeps an undamped SDOF from integrating a whole burn's sustained oscillation (an undamped resonance grows without bound over a
    long record).  Z3 exists only inside the light window: the FA1S rows are solved at the FA-1 thermal state of a light (45.6 C); a head
    above 63.1 bar abs later in a run is outside the envelope.  Sample step <= 0.05 ms (the grid's own) over the window.
    Period domain 0.02-50 ms (REV-COMB-4's, ADOPTED; not the brief's 0.005-2000 ms) because it is the domain a post-run check can
    evaluate and the only one where the bound can bind (numbers in 'grid_reproduction' and 'Z3_v2'): (a) the grid comes within 50 bar of
    FA1S only inside 0.02-50 ms (periods listed); (b) below 0.02 ms S -> the peak (quasi-static limit; the excess over the 88.02 peak is the
    unclipped from-rest start below ambient), bounded by the 88.1 ceiling; (c) above 50 ms S tends to 1.01325 + 2 x (the level held) plus
    the pulse impulse term, which the zone rules bound (grid and plateau / burn-on families in this file, far below FA1S); (d) the
    signal: B-DPC-1 (stand, 51.2 kS/s, flat to >= 10 kHz incl. the mount, AC coupled -3 dB 0.5 Hz) resolves T >= 0.1 ms and, DC-restored
    with C1 (the first-order coupling inverted, pre-light level from C1), the long end; 0.02-0.1 ms is beyond its flat band and is
    evaluated as recorded (piecewise linear), which does not bind (grid well below FA1S there, the >= 0.8 ms 10-90 % rise keeping the
    dynamic factor there <= 1.032 for a linear rise); SIL plant traces (25 us step) resolve all of it; the flight 1 kHz record cannot
    (Z3 v2 NOT EVALUATED in flight: the LIGHT_SPIKE raw peak is a lower bound).
    MEASURED TRACES: an undamped oscillator has no loss, so on a measured trace S integrates the trace noise over the window (a coherent
    tone of amplitude a at the period T adds about a pi N, N the cycles of T in the window: 135 a at 3.5 ms and 942 a at 0.5 ms over
    150 ms; white noise adds a response growing with the square root of the window; 'noise_sensitivity_measured_traces').  The test is
    exact on SIM traces (the grid, the SIL S6R / N-04 plant traces) and conservative on measured ones: the stand use needs a no-event
    B-DPC-1 record through inside_v2 first (TO-VERIFY); a damped variant (published v2.4b head|all|zeta0.02 envelope 142.62 bar abs at
    3.425 ms against 146.88 undamped) needs the structure's damping shown (MISSING) and is OPEN for the lead, not adopted.
(2) J-FWD REPLACE RULE RESTATED (F3, R4-10, 5 (f)(ii)).  The level stays 60.0 bar abs; the quantity and its basis change:
      quantity  Q_JFWD = max(the head peak over the record, max over T in 0.2-0.5 ms of S(T) on the light window and on each
                excursion window: 50 ms before to 150 ms after an upward crossing of 45 bar abs later in the run, SDOF from
                equilibrium at its start): the J-FWD sees the peak quasi-statically through the parts and the J-FWD band dynamically
                through the screws (TC-02 head on its screws 0.272-0.385 ms, v3.5 S-AX modal, mechanical.json /fa1/periods_and_dlf,
                CHANGELOG 176; the v3.5.2 ten IN718 screws shorten it by about 13 %: band 0.2-0.5 ms ASSUMED, TO-VERIFY);
      level     60.0 bar abs: the highest head pressure at which every J-FWD row meets the nominal factors at the LC2 thermal state
                (78.6 C) on an FE state: the yield slot 1.5 x 6.0 = 9.0 MPa IS js5b LC2U (SF 1.0 on the factored state, lead R7 form),
                every row positive (TC-01 +0.328, TC-02 +1.362, screw +1.583); the ultimate slot 2.0 x 6.0 = 12.0 MPa is FA1D 12.1 MPa
                (45.6 C, +0.355) and, at 78.6 C, the TC-01 ligament trend +0.312 [DERIVED]; above 60 bar abs the J-FWD has only SF 1.0
                rows (FA1D / FA1U / FA1S: the line-231 one-off abnormal basis, Neuber local strain, 233 (4) replace);
      duration  none: one exceedance at any time in the run;
      count     298 of the 896 FA-1 grid cases (the peak alone, the v1 quantity and LEAD 256 (4): 185; the 113 added cases peak at
                49.8-60.0 bar abs with J-FWD-band ESP above 60) [SIM grid counts on an ASSUMED construct, not rates of normal lights];
      signal    stand: B-DPC-1 DC-restored with C1 (step <= 0.05 ms in the windows), C1 for the peak elsewhere; SIL: the plant head
                pressure; flight: the C1 LIGHT_SPIKE raw peak (1 kHz) is a lower bound, so Electronics states the flight threshold from
                its C1 chain model on the 896 grid (TO-VERIFY), this file giving the ideal-sampler bound.
    NOT meant for normal-light transients: a normal light stays in Z0 (head <= MEOP 45 bar abs, the LC2 basis) and a smooth rise to
    45 bar abs gives Q_JFWD far below 60 (numbers in 'jfwd_rule_v2'); Q_JFWD > 60 marks a light that loaded the J-FWD beyond its 60 bar
    abs basis, an abnormal event by the structural basis whatever its cause.  The grid counts are FA-1 hard-start bracket cases (A1
    fuel-assisted relight), SIM on an ASSUMED construct, not a rate of normal lights (R4-10).
(3) F4: the TB-state abort set HW_OVERPRESSURE, PC_OVERPRESSURE, HARD_START is CONFIRMED, with PC_SENSOR raised on the HIGH side and
    OVER_TEMP (F-14) beside it; the trace rule (2) covers the ridden-through events (block 'F4_abort_set').
(4) The v1 cases are re-checked with inside_v2(); the v3.5.2 margin matrix (rows v8 publication) replaces the v3.5.1 per-zone record
    (kept beside).

criterion.period_grid: the published 406 periods (periods_z3_ms(): 0.02-1.0 step 0.005, 1.0-5.0 step 0.025, 5-50 at 40 per decade plus 6 / 7.5 / 10 / 12.5 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50)
criterion.convention: S(T) = 1.01325 + max x, undamped SDOF from rest at the record start (before the light), g = P - 1.01325 bar piecewise linear between samples, held at its last value after the record (free vibration added), the larger of g clipped at 0 and g unclipped (Combustion v2.4b 16.2 / REV-COMB-4)
criterion.record: one light's head-end pressure from before the light (first sample at or below 2.0 bar abs) to the end of that burn; S on the LIGHT WINDOW (record start to 150 ms after the first crossing of 8 bar abs), from rest at the record start, held after the window; Z3 only inside the light window (a head above 63.1 bar abs later in a run is outside the envelope: the FA1S rows are solved at the FA-1 thermal state of a light, 45.6 C); every grid record ends 61-129 ms after the light, so the grid evaluation is the published convention exactly
criterion.trace_requirement: sample step <= 0.05 ms over the light window: B-DPC-1 (51.2 kS/s, DC-restored with C1) on the stand; the SIL plant head pressure (25 us) for S6R / N-04; the flight 1 kHz record does not qualify (NOT EVALUATED); exact on SIM traces, conservative on measured ones, where the undamped test integrates the trace noise (noise_sensitivity_measured_traces: a no-event stand record is checked first, TO-VERIFY)
criterion.why_a_window: an undamped SDOF integrates without loss: over a whole burn a sustained oscillation at a structural period (for example a chamber acoustic mode in the 0.2-0.5 ms J-FWD band) grows without bound in the computed response, which a structure with any damping does not do; the window keeps the evaluation to the light transient, the form in which the grid and FA1S were set
criterion.adoption: REV-COMB-4 Z3' ADOPTED AS WRITTEN (ceiling 88.1, ESP <= 151.04 at 0.02-50 ms) plus the v1 window (<= 3.0 ms above 63.1) and rise (>= 0.8 ms) conditions KEPT as the FA-1 class; every grid case meets both kept conditions, so the grid classification equals Z3' exactly

noise_sensitivity_measured_traces.statement: an undamped oscillator has no loss: on a measured trace S(T) integrates the trace's noise over the window. A coherent tone of amplitude a at the period T adds about a pi N (N = cycles of T in the window; 150 ms: 135 a at 3.5 ms, 942 a at 0.5 ms, 2356 a at 0.2 ms); white noise of rms r over a bandwidth B adds a response of rms (2 pi / T) r sqrt(t_w / B) / 2. The Z3 v2 test and Q_JFWD are exact on SIM traces (the FA-1 grid, the SIL S6R / N-04 plant traces) and conservative on measured ones, where noise alone can trip them

jfwd_rule_v2.rule: J-FWD REPLACE RULE (LC-TB70 v2): when Q_JFWD of a run's head-end pressure exceeds 60.0 bar abs at any time, the joint counts as used: before the next run the line-231 J-FWD inspection (C6 (2) list: the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws and their HW-170 springs replaced, new, single-use; the TC-01 holes gauged with the pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62, a hole that takes the 5.62 pin rejected; hole edges and the bore within 3 mm of a hole at 10x; S01 / S02 replaced; the removed screws inspected per C6 (3)) and the TC-02 taps gauged (M5-6H GO / NO-GO)

jfwd_rule_v2.normal_lights: NOT meant for normal-light transients. A normal light stays in Z0 (head <= MEOP 45 bar abs, the LC2 basis): a linear rise from ambient to 45 bar abs held gives Q_JFWD 50.647 bar abs at a 0.8 ms 10-90 % rise and 54.555 at 0.4 ms, and reaches 60 only with a 10-90 % rise below 0.2879 ms [DERIVED]; the commanded start ramps thrust at <= 2500 N/s after the light (t10-90 0.140 s, kStartRamp_Nps, combustion v2.4c). No FA-1 grid case with a head peak at or below 49.781 bar abs exceeds 60 (113 of the 298 triggering cases peak at or below 60.0) [DERIVED on SIM]. Q_JFWD > 60 therefore marks a light that loaded the J-FWD beyond its 60 bar abs basis (a peak above 60, or a peak near it with fast J-FWD-band content): an abnormal event by the structural basis, whatever its cause (Z2 above 60.0, Z3). On a measured trace noise in the band can also trip it ('noise_sensitivity_measured_traces')
jfwd_rule_v2.peak_only_alternative_for_the_lead: the head peak alone (the v1 quantity and LEAD 256 (4)) flags 185 of the 896 grid cases; Q_JFWD adds 113 cases whose peak is 49.781-60.0 bar abs but whose J-FWD-band ESP exceeds 60 (Q / peak in gauge up to 1.2989); the peak alone does not see the J-FWD's dynamic load and is not adopted; it is robust to trace noise

reasons.PC_OVERPRESSURE: filtered Pc > 30 bar abs for 5 ms outside the ignition phase: the throat-blocked (TB) over-pressure in RUN; KEEP
reasons.HARD_START: filtered Pc > 30 bar abs for 5 ms in IGNITION / early RUN, or >= 4.75 V in IGNITION (and the ride-through T45 guard): the FA-1-class light; KEEP (it may also fire on lights below 60 bar abs: conservative)
reasons.PC_SENSOR_HIGH: a reading at or above 4.75 V (146.5 bar abs) is either a real head pressure far above 60 bar abs or a fault the record cannot tell from it (electronics.json open-wire rows: EXC- open drives the INA333 out of its common-mode range, output undefined, MISSING, B-PC-1): ADD the HIGH side; the LOW side (below 0.25 V: open wire, cable short) is not a pressure state and is not added
reasons.OVER_TEMP: already in F-14 (case TC > 150 C for 200 ms)
reasons.OVER_THRUST: flight only (FC_THRUST > 650 N on 3 frames): a pressure observable when Pc is invalid; NOT added as an abort type, because the trace rule covers it when the head trace resolves the event and the flight joint is not re-used before inspection; information for the lead
reasons.others: CMD, NO_IGNITION, FLAMEOUT, PC_BAND (a RUN band deviation for 150 ms: a high-side excursion above 30 bar abs is caught first by PC_OVERPRESSURE, 5 ms), TANK_OVERPRESSURE (never aborts a burn), GIMBAL_FAULT, PINTLE_FAULT, LINK_LOST, PREPRESS_FAIL, BATT_LOW, MV_FAULT, ARM_LOST, WATCHDOG, TVC_SUPPLY, OVERCURRENT, MAINT_JAM, TORCH_FAULT, RELIGHT_LOCKOUT, MODE_MISMATCH, BAY_HOT, TANK_HOT, BLEED_FAULT, TORCH_LOST, TANK_COLD, CASE_WARM_STAND: no head over-pressure and no TB thermal state by themselves; not added

F4_abort_set.beside_the_abort_set: the J-FWD replace rule (Q_JFWD > 60 bar abs) applies to every run whatever its end: it covers the ridden-through FA-1 pulses (flight ride-through, no abort) and any Z2 / Z3 excursion without an abort

rules: J-FWD REPLACE RULE (LC-TB70 v2): when Q_JFWD of a run's head-end pressure exceeds 60.0 bar abs at any time, the joint counts as used: before the next run the line-231 J-FWD inspection (C6 (2) list: the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws and their HW-170 springs replaced, new, single-use; the TC-01 holes gauged with the pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62, a hole that takes the 5.62 pin rejected; hole edges and the bore within 3 mm of a hole at 10x; S01 / S02 replaced; the removed screws inspected per C6 (3)) and the TC-02 taps gauged (M5-6H GO / NO-GO); Q_JFWD = max(head peak, ESP at 0.2-0.5 ms), no minimum duration (jfwd_rule_v2)
an event that leaves the envelope is outside the structural basis: no margin claim, engine quarantined for inspection (v1, kept)

one Z3 event per J-FWD assembly: the line-231 basis is a one-off abnormal event; a second Z3 excursion before the replacement is outside the envelope (stated in v2; OPEN for the lead where it bears on the flight relight)
Z3_v2_text: Z3 (LC-TB70 v2): 63.1 < P_head <= 88.1 bar abs inside the light window (record start before the light to 150 ms after the first crossing of 8 bar abs), with the undamped SDOF ESP of the head-end pressure on that window <= 151.04 bar abs (FA1S) at every period 0.02-50 ms (the published 406-period grid; from rest at the record start, g = P - 1.01325 bar piecewise linear and held after the window, the larger of g clipped at 0 and unclipped; sample step <= 0.05 ms), the window above 63.1 bar abs <= 3.0 ms and the 10-90 % rise >= 0.8 ms; REV-COMB-4 Z3' adopted as written with the two v1 shape conditions kept; exact on SIM traces, conservative on measured traces (the undamped test integrates noise: a no-event stand record is checked first, TO-VERIFY); 896 of 896 FA-1 grid cases inside (ESP max 146.881 at 3.5 ms, margin 4.159 bar; peak max 88.02; window max 1.6693 ms; rise min 0.8419 ms) [DERIVED on SIM]
jfwd_rule_v2_text: J-FWD replace rule (LC-TB70 v2): Q_JFWD > 60.0 bar abs at any time in a run (Q_JFWD = the larger of the head peak and the head ESP at the J-FWD periods 0.2-0.5 ms; no minimum duration): the joint counts as used; before the next run the line-231 J-FWD inspection (C6 (2) list: the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws and their HW-170 springs replaced, the TC-01 holes pin-gauged GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62, hole edges and bore at 10x, S01 / S02 replaced, removed screws per C6 (3)) and the TC-02 taps gauged (M5-6H GO / NO-GO). Basis: at 60.0 bar abs every J-FWD row meets the nominal factors at 78.6 C (yield slot 9.0 MPa = js5b LC2U, minimum MS_y +0.328 TC-01 ligament (LC2U); ultimate slot 12.0 MPa minimum MS_u +0.312 TC-01 ligament trend 78.6 C); above it only the SF 1.0 FA-1 rows (line-231 one-off). Not meant for normal lights (Z0, <= 45 bar abs: a rise to 45 bar abs trips it only below a 0.2879 ms 10-90 % rise); 298 of the 896 FA-1 hard-start bracket cases exceed it (185 by the peak alone) [SIM grid count on an ASSUMED construct, not a rate of normal lights]. Signal: SIL plant head pressure (exact); stand B-DPC-1 DC-restored with C1 (after a no-event noise check, TO-VERIFY); flight C1 LIGHT_SPIKE raw peak (lower bound) against Electronics' chain-model threshold (TO-VERIFY; ideal sampler 40.381 bar abs).
how_to_use: Electronics: for each light, its head-end pressure record from before the light (first sample at or below 2.0 bar abs) to the end of that burn (S6R / N-04: the SIL plant head pressure at the 25 us plant step, from before the relight; stand: B-DPC-1 DC-restored with C1; sample step <= 0.05 ms at least over the light window, record start to 150 ms after the first crossing of 8 bar abs, and over each excursion window, 50 ms before to 150 ms after a later upward crossing of 45 bar abs) goes to inside_v2(t_s, p_bar_abs) in lc_tb70_envelope.py (import with python3 -B -I; main() does not run on import); it returns inside (None when a Z3 record cannot evaluate the ESP), the zone, the reasons, the ESP maximum and its period, Q_JFWD and the J-FWD rule flag. The 10 S6R runs (fa1rep max_face alone / then 50 bar abs, five builds each) and the 29-33 N-04 burn-on cases are re-classified this way. A record whose step is coarser than 0.05 ms in a window (the flight 1 kHz log) returns the ESP not evaluated and Q_JFWD as a lower bound. On a measured stand trace the undamped ESP integrates the trace noise: run a record with no event (cold flow or ignition-only) through inside_v2 first ('noise_sensitivity_measured_traces').
